# US Consumer Sentiment Falls as Inflation Expectations Rise

The University of Michigan’s consumer sentiment index fell to 47.8 in early September 2026, down for a second consecutive month and well below market expectations of 51.0, according to the preliminary estimate.

It was the weakest reading since May’s record low.

# U.S. consumer sentiment takes a hit in September

Source: Xinhua

Editor: huaxia

2026-09-12 21:39:15

People shop at a supermarket in New York, the United States, Aug. 26, 2026. (Xinhua/Zhang Fengguo)

WASHINGTON, Sept. 12 (Xinhua) -- U.S. consumer sentiment took a hit in September, according to preliminary data released Friday from the University of Michigan. Experts have warned of the weak economy ahead of the midterm elections.
